body:
## Ambition
Make the public websites of the 198x family visually distinctive, welcoming, accessible, exceptionally usable and coherent as one ecosystem. The experience should convey historical computing's creativity while meeting contemporary standards; do not reproduce the limitations of vintage interfaces.

## Principles
- **Family resemblance, product individuality.** Share identity, typography principles, tokens, navigation conventions and interaction quality while allowing Code198x, Asm198x, Emu198x and others to serve different audiences.
- **Real journeys over screenshots.** Optimise finding a machine/lesson, choosing a path, running a code example, reading documentation, downloading/installing a tool, debugging a problem and moving between siblings.
- **Accessibility as a requirement.** Keyboard/screen-reader use, focus visibility, contrast, reduced motion, readable typography, responsive mobile/tablet/desktop layouts and meaningful alt text.
- **Performance as experience.** Evaluate load time, layout shifts, interaction responsiveness, media loading and embedded WASM startup with real host/browser devices and budgets derived from baselines.
- **Evidence rather than taste alone.** Combine expert review with user research, representative tasks, usability testing and measurable regressions.
- **Art direction with purpose.** Historically evocative imagery, diagrams, typography and motion must improve comprehension and orientation rather than become decoration or nostalgia cosplay.
- **Cross-platform/browser quality.** Test major browsers on Windows, macOS, Linux and relevant mobile platforms. Publish explicit compatibility and limitations.
- **Sustainable implementation.** Audit the current sites and design systems before adding a shared component framework. Reuse design primitives where warranted; avoid lockstep redesigns and big-bang rewrites.

## Learning and trust gates

- Remove avoidable setup and navigation barriers while making prerequisites, machine constraints, evidence limits and the next useful action easy to find. Offer progressive explanation and inspection without requiring every visitor to become an expert first.
- Preserve user agency over running examples, downloads, media and motion. Essential information must remain reachable through the site's accessible fallback appropriate to that journey.
- Apply #108's accountability to AI-assisted implementation and copy. Support public claims with the relevant evidence and source links; revise or remove an interaction or claim that fails the journey's accessibility, reliability or performance gate.

## Site-specific ambitions
- Code198x: engaging learning environment connecting Foundations, machine tracks, Vault, Pattern Library, runnable examples and exercises; efficient discovery and clear learning progress.
- Asm198x: discoverable capabilities, dialect/machine support, approachable browser assembler, docs, diagnostics and installation.
- Emu198x: machine discovery, trustworthy capabilities, downloads and documentation; coherent browser emulation, input/media and educational inspection.
- Build/Format/Debug/ISA/other siblings: product-specific journeys with the same baseline quality but appropriate content density and vocabulary.

## First milestones
- [ ] Audit representative public sites on mobile/tablet/desktop, dark/light and keyboard/screen-reader flows; inventory actual design consistency and friction.
- [ ] Define a small, shared brand/design/UX quality charter, accessibility acceptance and visual regression strategy.
- [ ] Map 3–5 actual user journeys per flagship site, capture baseline findings and prioritise defects.
- [ ] Pilot one bounded, high-impact improvement on Code198x and one tool website, with before/after findings.
- [ ] Add proportionate cross-browser, responsive, accessibility and performance checks to site releases.

Coordinate with quality charter #108, educational quality #110, and sibling product epics. Do not claim a site is excellent from AI critique or generated mockups alone; test with users.
title: [Epic] Establish exceptional website design, accessibility and user experience across 198x
